units.rawText: <color=#1E90FF>Taking me to observe the stars? What nostalgia this summons. Just what have I cast away? I struggle to remember.</color>
units.displayText: Taking me to observe the stars? What nostalgia this summons. Just what have I cast away? I struggle to remember.

spans.text: Taking me to observe the stars? What nostalgia this summons. Just what have I cast away? I struggle to remember.

units.rawText: <color=#1E90FF>The faraway stars are beautiful, no? Yet they lie so far away…</color>
units.displayText: The faraway stars are beautiful, no? Yet they lie so far away…

spans.text: The faraway stars are beautiful, no? Yet they lie so far away…

units.rawText: <color=#1E90FF>each and every strand of light they send forth must cross a gap of a thousand million light-years. Not unlike me, unknowing of when I would return…</color>
units.displayText: each and every strand of light they send forth must cross a gap of a thousand million light-years. Not unlike me, unknowing of when I would return…

spans.text: each and every strand of light they send forth must cross a gap of a thousand million light-years. Not unlike me, unknowing of when I would return…

units.rawText: <color=#1E90FF>That was an agonizing and burdensome time indeed, but if I slowly think back to the place where each and every star belongs, I find it in myself to be calm. To... bear the pain a little better.</color>
units.displayText: That was an agonizing and burdensome time indeed, but if I slowly think back to the place where each and every star belongs, I find it in myself to be calm. To... bear the pain a little better.
